svg.title: Not-So-Smart Thermostat, slide 1
svg.desc: Boomer Slate points proudly at a new wall thermostat while Wes, Clara, Mina, Dex, and Token gather around. Boomer says, ‘Good news—the new smart thermostat is installed. It can finally read the room.’

g.data-exact-copy: Good news—the new smart thermostat is installed. It can finally read the room.
